verdict.rationale: The only automation evidence is that feature rules can be scheduled and ramped (docs-22) and that ramp schedules are a paid-tier feature (docs-37). These are time-based automatic changes, not general event-triggered actions; feature 'rules' themselves are targeting/override rules, not automation rules. Missing for 10: event-driven triggers (webhooks or event subscriptions), user-defined condition→action automation rules, actions triggered by metric or experiment events, and any hands-on corroboration.
